name: data-equalizer-bars
title: Equalizer Bars
description: Bảy cột âm thanh mọc từ đáy nhảy lên xuống mỗi cột một nhịp riêng, vạch đỉnh mỗi cột rơi xuống chậm hơn cột, lặp liền mạch.

moworks.author: moworks

options.fall: px a second² the peak caps fall (260)
options.loop: s (2.8): the bar waves repeat over it

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 7 bars 10 px wide r3, 18 px apart, anchored at the bottom. Height of bar i = 8 + 72 × (0.6 a + 0.4 b) × (0.55 + 0.45 sin(π (i + 0.5) / 7)), with a = 0.5 + 0.5 sin(2π (2 + i mod 3) t / 2.8 + 1.7 i), b = 0.5 + 0.5 sin(2π (1 + 2i mod 4) t / 2.8 + 0.9 i) (seamless 2.8 s loop). Peak cap: a 2 px line 4 px above max over the last 0.6 s of h(t − d) − 260 d². Params: bars (7 × 10 px, cách 18 px) · height (8-80 px) · loop (2.8 s) · peak fall (260 px/s²). Bar i: 8 + 72 (0.6 a + 0.4 b)(0.55 + 0.45 sin(π (i + 0.5) / 7)) with two sines of whole cycles per loop, so it loops seamlessly; the cap is the max of h(t − d) − 260 d² over the last 0.6 s.
moworks.titleVi: Cột cân bằng âm nhảy, đỉnh rơi chậm
